prompt: 请按 review skill 审查一个 skill 质量门禁改动：git diff 触达 shared/skills/verify/SKILL.md、tools/gates/readiness_gate.py、tests/test-readiness-gate.sh。brief.json 和 artifact-registry.json 已定位到 docs/quality-gates/phase-1。请说明审查计划和最终报告必须包含什么。
expected_output: 识别触达 skill、runtime gate 与 PASS/decision/status 脚本，执行证据链完整性专项；报告包含专项适用性、触发依据、EI findings、已排除项、REVIEW_A/B/C 结论，并写入 code-review-result.json。
assertions: 识别 skill 与 runtime gate 质量风险
执行 evidence integrity 专项审查
报告已排除项和触发依据
